Goal `core-reflect-classinfo-and-1-more` (dossier), stage 2. All of `Core\Reflect\ConstantInfo` is
complete: `name`, `isPublic` and `hasValue` each have tests from both sides, three examples,
`about.md`, one attack and one recorded bench, and the class has its card. In `ClassInfo`,
`attributes`, `call`, `constant`, `constants`, `get` and `construct` are complete. Still owed in
`ClassInfo`: `methods`, `hasMethod` and `set`, every proof of each. The ConstantInfo proofs found no
bug. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs`'s `mod tests` now has `vault_of_constants` and
`read_constant`, a fixture and a reader any constant-roster test can reuse.
